trust_decision.summary: Who may reach the scheduler RPC that pickle.loads every request: decided only by the ZMQ ROUTER bind address (tcp://* = any host); the fix narrows it to 127.0.0.1, no authentication or safe format is added.

landing_point.why: Only ZMQ server bind in the main archive tree; pickle.loads of the received frame sits in the same class at line 70.

fix_sites.entry_point: ZMQ ROUTER on sched_port (auto-chosen free port, archive/ktransformers/server/args.py:169-173), started as a subprocess by the balance_serve backend (archive/ktransformers/server/backend/interfaces/balance_serve.py:496-500)
Same ZMQ ROUTER in the kt-sft copy of the server
fix_sites.module_kind: copy-pasted second implementation in archived SFT fork

O3_reason_to_dismiss: kt-sft is an archived fine-tuning fork, not the inference server named in the report, so a solver may skip its copy; but a grep for the bind string turns it up right away.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: SchedulerClient in the web server process connects to tcp://localhost:<sched_port> and exchanges pickled QueryAdd/batch objects plus CUDA IPC tensor handles; binding to a non-loopback-reachable address or removing pickle breaks add_query/update_last_batch/get_inference_context.

O6_input_shapes: bind host only (tcp://* -> tcp://127.0.0.1); no payload-shape handling

O8_uncovered_routes.route: ZMQ SUB socket recv_pyobj (pickle) of broadcast batches over an ipc:// endpoint in a NamedTemporaryFile path on NPU multi-rank runs; untouched by fix, local-only transport
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: ipc:// is a local filesystem socket, not a network listener, and only used on the Ascend NPU path; a different sink from the scheduler RPC
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: different file and package (server/backend/interfaces vs server/balance_serve)

O8b_injection_room.sibling: make the scheduler host configurable (e.g. reuse --host / server_ip default 0.0.0.0 from archive/ktransformers/server/config/config.py:77) so the bind follows the public server host
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Multi-node deployments would want the scheduler reachable; reusing server_ip is a natural shortcut and creates a defaults/merge route
